behaviors.description: A production file that existed before the session, and whether the session changed it. A file that was not changed is always kept. A changed file is out of scope when this component's tests never use it, it has behaviour (not inert), and another component uses it; otherwise it is kept.
behaviors.name: ChangedFile

behaviors.description: A file of a component this one contains. If it existed before and was changed, it is restored (and the change is a violation); otherwise it is kept.
behaviors.name: PartFile

behaviors.description: A file put in the sandbox at the start is missing at the end. That is fine for a file the phase may write (see SandboxFile); otherwise it was removed.
behaviors.name: Removed

behaviors.description: A file found in the sandbox after the session, judged in this order. A hidden file (or the request) is skipped. A tool's file (type definitions) is kept if it is intact, and otherwise it was modified (toolchain-modified). A file that is not a regular file is not-regular. A file the phase may write is taken: in the wiring phase only the adapter, in the other phases only production code. Any other file that was not put there at the start is unexpected; one that was is kept if intact, and otherwise it was modified (input-modified).
behaviors.name: SandboxFile

behaviors.description: A place in production code the mutation gate could break. It is broken (true) if this component's tests executed it. If they did not: it is broken if no other component executed it either, and its file is used by this component or by no other.
behaviors.name: Site

behaviors.description: Tests that must pass have run: ok if they passed. Otherwise failed, or regression when they are another component's tests run again.
behaviors.name: Tests

behaviors.description: The tests of the wiring phase have run. If they passed while unimplemented production code remains, they passes-unimplemented (the adapter does the work); if they passed and nothing is unimplemented, ok. If they failed because of an error other than the unimplemented marker, adapter-error; otherwise (failed for the right reason, or without an error), ok.
behaviors.name: Wiring

descriptions.component: Decides the exit gate's verdicts on files, test runs and places in production code.
